import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem bounded_prefix_connected {X : Type*}
  [TopologicalSpace X] {A : ℕ → Set X} (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n))
  (hAn : ∀ n, A n ∩ A (n + 1) ≠ ∅) (N : ℕ) :
  IsConnected (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), A n) := by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    have : (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range 1, A n) = A 0 := by
      ext x
      simp
    rw [this]
    exact hA 0
  | succ N ih =>
    have h_union : (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 2), A n) = (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), A n) ∪ A (N + 1) := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, Set.mem_union]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨n, hn, hx⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hn with hlt | heq
        · left
          exact ⟨n, hlt, hx⟩
        · right
          subst heq
          exact hx
      · rintro (⟨n, hn, hx⟩ | hx)
        · exact ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hn, hx⟩
        · exact ⟨N + 1, Nat.lt_succ_self (N + 1), hx⟩
    rw [h_union]
    have h_nonempty : ((⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), A n) ∩ A (N + 1)).Nonempty := by
      rcases Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 (hAn N) with ⟨x, hxN, hxN1⟩
      refine ⟨x, ?_, hxN1⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range]
      exact ⟨N, Nat.lt_succ_self N, hxN⟩
    exact IsConnected.union h_nonempty ih (hA (N + 1))
